posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked: I was just curious about changes in the Enhanced Edition. We know about scaling with H, hp tracking, errata, typos, and art for the environment cards. Aside from changes to specific cards like Chastise or Wrest the Mind, are there going to be any “balance”-like changes? For instance, increasing or decreasing damage of particular cards/powers? I know that many people believe that certain characters are too weak/strong, and while characters in this game obviously don’t NEED to balanced in the same way that say, an MMO does, I was curious if there might be any changes like this in the Enhanced Edition.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
1. Will the card back of all the decks be updated?
    Not much if at all; that is up to Adam!

  2. Will any existing art be updated?
    Yes; quite a bit, actually.

  3. Will the new box hold just the base game plus 2 expansions? Will there be space for a third or fourth expansion?
    Just core + 2 expansions for now. If we release more expansions, we will release additional storage options at that time

  4. Will the storage solution be sleeve friendly?
    Yes.

  5. Will Young Legacy be re-released with thicker card stock? This is just for OCD me.
    No.

  6. What will the HP counters look like?
    See Update #1 on Kickstarter!

  7. Will there be damage count modifier counters? Damage type modifier counters?
    Yes to both.

  8. Will the pdf for existing first edition owners include the remastered environment decks with new art?
    Yes.

Yes.
